title: Can I Publish My Improved Version?

zones.label: CC0
zones.summary: Yes: Nothing is required, and giving credit is good practice.
facts: May you publish an improved version? Yes.
What you must do: Nothing is required, and giving credit is good practice.

zones.label: CC BY
zones.summary: Yes, with conditions: Credit the author, link to the license, and say that you changed the work.
facts: May you publish an improved version? Yes, with conditions.
What you must do: Credit the author, link to the license, and say that you changed the work.

zones.label: CC BY-SA
zones.summary: Yes, with conditions: The same as CC BY, and release your version under CC BY-SA.
facts: May you publish an improved version? Yes, with conditions.
What you must do: The same as CC BY, and release your version under CC BY-SA.

zones.label: CC BY-NC
zones.summary: Yes, without commercial use: The same as CC BY, and do not sell or use it for commercial gain.
facts: May you publish an improved version? Yes, without commercial use.
What you must do: The same as CC BY, and do not sell or use it for commercial gain.

zones.label: CC BY-NC-SA
zones.summary: Yes, without commercial use: The same as CC BY, release under CC BY-NC-SA, and do not use it commercially.
facts: May you publish an improved version? Yes, without commercial use.
What you must do: The same as CC BY, release under CC BY-NC-SA, and do not use it commercially.

zones.label: CC BY-ND
zones.summary: No: You may not share a changed version. You may make changes for your own private use only.
facts: May you publish an improved version? No.
What you must do: You may not share a changed version. You may make changes for your own private use only.

zones.label: No license, all rights reserved
zones.summary: No. Ask the owner for permission first.
facts: With no license, the default is all rights reserved.
An improved version is a derivative work, which the owner controls.
Ask the owner for permission before you edit or share it.

quiz.question: Which card says you may not share a changed version, only change it for private use?
quiz.explanation: ND means no derivatives to share.

quiz.question: Which card says nothing is required, though credit is good practice?
quiz.explanation: CC0 puts the work in the public domain.

quiz.question: Which card says release your version under the same license and credit the author?
quiz.explanation: ShareAlike keeps adaptations open the same way.

quiz.question: Which zone says ask the owner for permission first?
quiz.explanation: All rights are reserved by default.

quiz.question: Which card allows publishing an improved version only without commercial use, under the same license?
